search_log: Listed every filing of Insmed (CIK 1104506) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks with item 2.02 (2018-10 to 2026-11) and every 10-Q/10-K; parsed every table row.

2018Q4-2025Q2: the revenue line of each quarter's release ('Revenues' 2018Q4, 'Revenues, net' 2019Q1-2020Q3, 'Product revenues, net' from 2020Q4), ARIKAYCE being the only product. 2025Q3 on: 'Total' line of the ARIKAYCE block in the 10-Q product revenue table (thousands); 2025Q4 = 10-K full year less nine months. The releases from 2025Q3 print the ARIKAYCE block in millions to one decimal and are not used.

Checks: every Q4 release through 2024 prints the full year equal to the sum of its quarters (verify_staged_manifests sum check); 2025: 92,823 + 107,415 + 114,291 + 119,236 = 433,765, the 10-K's ARIKAYCE total.
